segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹפָר שֶׁנִּסְדַּק וְדִבְּקוֹ — פָּסוּל. דִּיבֵּק שִׁבְרֵי שׁוֹפָרוֹת — פָּסוּל.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A shofar that was cracked and» then «glued together,» even though it appears to be whole, is «unfit.» Similarly, if «one glued together broken fragments of shofarot» to form a complete shofar, the shofar is «unfit.»

segments.he: נִיקַּב וּסְתָמוֹ, אִם מְעַכֵּב אֶת הַתְּקִיעָה — פָּסוּל, וְאִם לָאו — כָּשֵׁר. הַתּוֹקֵעַ לְתוֹךְ הַבּוֹר אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַדּוּת אוֹ לְתוֹךְ הַפִּיטָס, אִם קוֹל שׁוֹפָר שָׁמַע — יָצָא, וְאִם קוֹל הֲבָרָה שָׁמַע — לָא יָצָא.
segments.en: If the shofar «was punctured and» the puncture «was sealed, if it impedes the blowing,» the shofar is «unfit, but if not,» it is «fit.» If «one sounds» a shofar «into a pit, or into a cistern, or into» a large «jug, if he» clearly «heard the sound of the shofar, he has fulfilled» his obligation; «but if he heard the sound of an echo, he has not fulfilled» his obligation.

segments.he: וְכֵן מִי שֶׁהָיָה עוֹבֵר אֲחוֹרֵי בֵּית הַכְּנֶסֶת, אוֹ שֶׁהָיָה בֵּיתוֹ סָמוּךְ לְבֵית הַכְּנֶסֶת, וְשָׁמַע קוֹל שׁוֹפָר אוֹ קוֹל מְגִילָּה, אִם כִּוֵּון לִבּוֹ — יָצָא, וְאִם לָאו — לֹא יָצָא. אַף עַל פִּי שֶׁזֶּה שָׁמַע וְזֶה שָׁמַע, זֶה כִּוֵּון לִבּוֹ, וְזֶה לֹא כִּוֵּון לִבּוֹ.
segments.en: «And similarly,» if «one was passing behind a synagogue, or his house was adjacent to the synagogue, and he heard the sound of the shofar or the sound of the Scroll» of Esther being read, «if he focused his heart,» i.e. his intent, to fulfill his obligation, «he has fulfilled» his obligation; «but if not, he has not fulfilled» his obligation. It is therefore possible for two people to hear the shofar blasts, but only one of them fulfills his obligation. «Even though this one heard and» also «the other one heard,» nevertheless, «this one focused his heart» to fulfill his obligation and has therefore indeed fulfilled it, «but the other one did not focus his heart,» and so he has not fulfilled his obligation.

moves.summary: a cracked and glued shofar, or one glued from fragments, is unfit
a punctured and sealed shofar is unfit only if the seal impedes the blowing
blowing into a pit, cistern or jug: one fulfills the obligation if he heard the shofar's sound, not if he heard an echo

moves.cueHe: וכן מי שהיה עובר אחורי בית הכנסת
moves.summary: one passing behind a synagogue who hears the shofar or the Megilla fulfills his obligation only if he directed his heart

positions.claim: a shofar cracked and glued, or assembled from fragments, is unfit; a sealed puncture disqualifies only if it impedes the blowing
one who hears the sound of the shofar itself from a pit or cistern has fulfilled his obligation, but not one who hears an echo
one who hears the shofar or the Megilla passing behind a synagogue fulfills his obligation only if he directed his heart
